A lean adult male human ranger with a readable calm face, dark brown hair, muted moss-green hood and short shoulder mantle, russet brown quilted leather jerkin, dark taupe trousers, gloves and moderate brown boots, quiver behind right shoulder. A plain long wooden bow, with a visibly straight taut bowstring when relaxed and curved limbs, long arrows. Match knight's painted detail and human realism. Camera: orthographic shallow18-degree elevation, BACK-RIGHT THREE-QUARTER, facing away toward upper screen-right, see back of hair and rear armor and a little right-side profile, same facing in ALL44cells. Maintain functional anatomical handedness; do not mirror weapon hands. Detailed painted brushwork/crisp material edges, warm muted light. Proportional anatomy, gloves, modest sensible boots. True clean transparency, no floor/shadow/text/labels/fringe. Large tall output2048x3840. EXACT4 COLUMNS x11 ROWS,44 separate fully visible figures, generous cell margins including weapons and lying body. SAME body size/head size in every row.
ROW1 four NEUTRAL IDLE breathing poses with relaxed upright straight legs, weapon safely lowered.
ROW2 four COMBAT IDLE breathing poses, weapon prepared forward at chest height.
ROWS3-4 EIGHT-frame natural NEUTRAL WALK loop, alternate left/right heel contact, loading, toe off, passing foot, normal modest stride, credible knee flexion.
ROWS5-6 EIGHT-frame natural COMBAT WALK loop, keep weapon in raised ready guard while feet alternate; never revert to weapon dangling at thigh.

ROWS10-11 EIGHT DEATH/FALL frames: struck, torso buckles, knees bend, knee ground, hand floor, body falls onto side, lands, final full body lying still. No gore. Articulated fall not rigid upright rotation. Fixed camera and facing, full silhouettes. Rows are chronological left to right; no omitted cells. Every sword/shaft remains straight and SAME physical length.
